summary: Approved iteration `feedback-request-batch-upload`. Source review confirms the delivered iteration satisfies the acceptance scope: protected `/dashboard/feedback-request` upload flow, `.xlsx` parsing, required column validation for `email`, `type`, `product_code`, `product_name`, and `purchase_date`, `type=purchase` enforcement, traceable `FeedbackBatch` and `Feedback` persistence tied to the authenticated user, database-unique feedback link identifiers, mockable Gmail-based feedback request email delivery, and sent/failed delivery status tracking. Prior defects were verified as remediated: duplicate required headers are rejected, impossible calendar dates no longer fall through to permissive JavaScript parsing, product fields are bounded, and uploaded filenames are sanitized. Fresh approved checks passed: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`; `npx.cmd prisma validate`; `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`; `npm.cmd run lint`; and `node --test .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\registration-profile-consent-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-email-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\registration\welcome-delivery-behavior.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\dashboard\dashboard-authenticated-shell-source.test.mjs .ai_factory\tests\unit\feedback\feedback-request-batch-upload-source.test.mjs` with 22/22 passing. Production build, browser verification, Playwright/e2e tests, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real email delivery were not run per task constraints and are not claimed as passed.
